goal: build be a calculator with all the functions
risks: Complexity of the user interface might be overwhelming for users
Advanced mathematical functions might be computationally expensive

tasks.title: Add basic arithmetic functions
tasks.description: Add add(a: float, b: float) -> float to app.py returning a + b; add subtract(a: float, b: float) -> float to app.py returning a - b; add multiply(a: float, b: float) -> float to app.py returning a * b; add divide(a: float, b: float) -> float to app.py returning a / b; add test_add, test_subtract, test_multiply, test_divide in test_app.py covering basic cases.
tasks.done_when: All tests pass for add, subtract, multiply, and divide functions.

tasks.title: Add advanced mathematical functions
tasks.description: Add power(base: float, exponent: float) -> float to app.py returning base ** exponent; add square_root(a: float) -> float to app.py returning the square root of a; add factorial(n: int) -> int to app.py returning the factorial of n; add test_power, test_square_root, test_factorial in test_app.py covering basic cases.
tasks.done_when: All tests pass for power, square_root, and factorial functions.

tasks.title: Add user interface
tasks.description: Create a simple command-line interface in app.py that allows users to input two numbers and select an operation (add, subtract, multiply, divide, power, square_root, factorial); add test_user_interface in test_app.py covering basic cases.
tasks.done_when: The user interface runs without errors and the tests pass.
